---
title: "Giving Back"
format: html
---

There are several ways to help grow and maintain the Open Science Dashboard.
Choose the option that best fits how you would like to contribute.

<details>
<summary><strong>Submit a New Open Science Tool / Resource</strong></summary>

1. Go to the repository's [**Issues** tab](https://github.com/shannonrankin/open-science-dashboard/issues) and click **New Issue**.
2. Select the **"Submit a New Dashboard Example"** template.
3. Complete the structured form:
   - **Title:** Use a clear title for the tool or resource (about 60 characters).
   - **URL:** Provide a direct, public web link.
   - **Description:** Write a one- to three-sentence summary of what the resource provides.
   - **Tools & Keywords:** Select all appropriate options. If a tool or keyword is not listed, enter it in the *Suggested New Tools* or *Suggested New Keywords* text box.
   - **Author / Organization:** Add your name, team, or the organization that created the resource.
   - **Image / Screenshot:** Drag and drop a thumbnail or screenshot into the markdown text block, or provide an image URL.
4. Submit the issue. An admin will review it and, once approved, an automated pull request will add the card to the dashboard.

</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>Submit a New Open Science Tip</strong></summary>

1. Go to the repository's [**Issues** tab](https://github.com/shannonrankin/open-science-dashboard/issues) and click **New Issue**.
2. Select the **"Submit an Open Science Tip"** template.
3. Complete the form:
   - **Tip Title:** Use a short, action-oriented title.
   - **Category:** Choose the open science area that best fits the tip.
   - **Tip Summary/Details:** Describe the quick tip, best practice, or snippet.
   - **Learn More Link:** Include a stable, publicly accessible resource for readers who want more information.
   - **Author/Credit:** Tell us how you would like to be credited.
4. Submit the issue for maintainer review. Tips do not need tool or keyword tags.

</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>Help Review & Maintain (Openscapes Mentors)</strong></summary>

1. If you are an Openscapes mentor interested in reviewing submissions or maintaining the dashboard, open a GitHub Issue using the standard issue form or a general issue.
2. Title the issue **"Help Review & Maintain the Open Science Dashboard"**.
3. Briefly describe your interest, relevant experience, and the types of contributions you would like to help review or maintain.
4. A maintainer will follow up to coordinate onboarding and next steps.

</details>
